intro: Mennet Carkad assigns promising rogues in the Undercity to hunt down Fenwick Thatros on orders directly from Lord Varimathras. Thatros is suspected of organizing independent undead forces along the shores of Silverpine Forest. Eliminating him proves an operative's mettle to the Deathstalkers, opening the way for more sophisticated trade training.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Lord Varimathras has just sent me a missive about a threat to the Forsaken that must be immediately removed. His name is Fenwick Thatros, one whom Lord Varimathras believes is a leader of the undead that have taken root in Silverpine Forest.
Your name came to mind immediately, friend. I have faith enough in your abilities that you will carry out this mission flawlessly.
The latest reports from the Deathstalkers in Silverpine indicate that Thatros can be found near the decrepit dock on Lordamere.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I have placed the utmost faith in you to perform this service for Lord Varimathras.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done well, friend. It occurs to me that you have performed many services for the Deathstalkers, proving your worth, and that perhaps it is time that we furthered your training in the shadow arts.
